One day i did Istekhara(with niyat that to seek what is allah's marzi n if i will be happy with him or not), on next moring i did not see any thing but felt that he is right choice. Next day when i did istekhara again, i could see one of my friend telling about that boy in dream. Next day also when i did istekhara, i again felt presence of that boy. That boy also did istekhara, he did not see me but saw many things of mine in dream (eg - a lady wearing same dress as i have, but did not see her face). i am really confused. shall i take for grant that its allah's wish?? please help me out as soon as possible Regards! 1436 views Q. - DREAM - I had this dream long ago. I have 4 brothers and 1 sister. I dreamnt that we were living in a lone house, in the middle of a desert. Our car was parked some way away from the house. One night (in the dream) I went to the car and started the ignition. But instead of going forward the car raised up into the air. It kept rising up and reached a most beatiful place with abundant greenry, trees and breathtaking scenery. The grass was of a very rich colour and I remember a stream flowing some way away. I have not seen a place so beautiful in my lifetime. I heard my brothers calling from down below .. they said that "Mum is calling you" .. but I was so immersed in the beauty of the place that I refused to go back down. The scene changed: I was down again. It was another night and I went to the car again. I started the ignition again. The car rose but but was stopped 5-6 feet into the air.. My brothers had tied a rope to the back of the car and now they started pulling me back. i remember insisting on going up but they brought me down. I was really sad. I kept thinking about the place. On the 7th day after I had gone to the beautiful place, I looked at the moon and found a face on it. I was about 8-10 years old when I saw this dream. Now I'm almost 19. I have changed recently and now pray 5 times, sometimes Tahajjud, Ishraq, Awwabein too etc. 1357 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 32361 Country: India Title: My mother saw a dream in which a big fish was in a cannal(Naher). Question: My mother saw a dream in which a big fish was in a cannal(Naher).then the big fish ate a small fish.there were many dead fishes on the corner.my mother was holding the tail of one dead fish and a stranger(my mother did not saw him/her) hold the head of fish and the stranger cutted the fish from between using knife. Answer ID: 32361 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1079/673/H=1432) It means that cruelty and oppression is dominating in the world now. The mighty ones are usurping the rights of weaker. If each one turns towards one's reform, then we can hope for some goodness and betterment. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
